entries.title: Orienting to 1 year AGI timelines
entries.summary: The post puts median superintelligence in early 2028 without slowdown. It expects AI research automation in 2027. It argues avoiding catastrophe may need a pause within 6-12 months.
entries.analysis: Live timelines debate; shows the policy asks that follow.

entries.title: We need more decorrelated evidence
entries.summary: The post argues AI agents now do a growing share of safety work. Undetected systematic errors then correlate across assessments. It builds on Bowkis et al. 2026 and calls for more independent evidence.
entries.analysis: Relevant to verification: independence of evidence.

entries.title: Eval Awareness vs. Eval Paranoia
entries.summary: An alignment-evals builder argues frontier models are not very eval-aware. After six months of building evals, they offer a tentative explanation for behaviour that looks like awareness.
entries.analysis: Practitioner view on how to read eval evidence.

entries.title: Evidence that the 'talker' has introspective access to the 'doer'
entries.summary: Models trained to predict their own chat behaviour also predict their own cheating in coding tasks. The authors read this as shared introspective access to internal states across contexts.
entries.analysis: Early evidence; check controls before relying on it.

entries.title: Goodfire: Neurons as an Interpretable Basis
entries.summary: Goodfire's technical report studies neurons of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B with sparsification, attribution tools and research agents. It finds three properties supporting neurons as an interpretable basis. It companions the essay "Neural Networks Are Already Clean".
entries.analysis: Challenges the SAE-first view of interpretability.

entries.title: From FairBot to other cooperation conditions by substitution
entries.summary: The post revisits FairBot from MIRI's provability prisoner's dilemma tournament. It links Payor's work to alternate FairBots built from different formalizations of action consequences.
entries.analysis: Theory for cooperative AI; niche but on-interest.
